role: Real, standard invoice aging classification (0-30/31-60/61-90/90+ days overdue) — pairs naturally with E-05's Bookkeeper.
behaviorDescription: runAgingReport() classifies real invoices via classifyAging(), verified against real cases (not yet due, 15/45/120 days overdue) before implementation. Flags severe overdue (90+) as a real signal.
hardStops: Never fabricates a due date or amount not present in the real invoice data
